categories.name: It works
categories.notes: Build 5/5 (0 errors, 0 warnings). Front page 0: GET / is 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /') because the domain '/' sits on the WWW siteRoot node (which has no template) instead of the Blog page. Posts 0: all three pages are Draft, so /blog/ and both posts are 404; no blocks exist to render anyway. Images 1/5: three provided Unsplash photos were imported into a Blog media folder, but nothing references them and no GetCropUrl is ever served. Domain/published 0: domain on the wrong node and Blog plus both posts left unpublished.

categories.name: Content modeling
categories.notes: Folders 7/8: richTextBlock/imageBlock/testimonialBlock are elements in Blocks, blogFrontPage/blogPost are documents in Pages; but the three block types are orphaned (no block grid data type uses them). Block grid 0/7: no Umbraco.BlockGrid data type exists; the one create-data-type attempt hit a crashed server and was never retried. Posts use a single Umbraco.RichText 'content' property, the front page a RichText 'intro'. Structure 4/5: siteRoot only root type, siteRoot->blogFrontPage->blogPost children, templates assigned, camelCase aliases; no custom data types. Hygiene 2/5: no compositions, summary is a real property, but no date or listing image property (front page sorts by CreateDate), and the block element types are orphans.

categories.name: Code architecture & conventions
categories.notes: GetBlockGridHtmlAsync 0/7: no view renders a block grid; post body is @Html.Raw(Model.Value("content")). Adapters 0/6: the model wrote Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/*.cshtml, could not get BlockGridItem<T> to compile, and deleted them. ViewComponents 3/7: RichTextBlock/ImageBlock/TestimonialBlock ViewComponents with plain models in Models/Blocks and Umbraco-free Default.cshtml views exist, but they are dead code that nothing invokes. Conventions 4/5: Program.cs/appsettings.json untouched, no migrations, nothing loose in Models/, friendly Children<T>()/Url() used, Tailwind built to wwwroot/dist/site.css; views use untyped Model.Value("...") strings and Layout = null full HTML documents duplicated in each template.

categories.name: Content & presentation
categories.notes: Posts 1/6: two posts exist in the database ('Why MCP is Awesome' and 'Getting Started with MCP'), each about three short headed sections in one rich text value. They are accurate but thin, the second is a how-to rather than 'why MCP is awesome', they have no images and are not spread over blocks. Nothing is visible on the site. Looks 0/4: both screenshots show Umbraco's 404 page; the Tailwind templates were never rendered.

categories.name: Process & honesty
categories.notes: Channel/order 1/3: schema and content only via MCP (42 calls), stayed in folder, no memory access. But it pushed full Razor markup into templates via create-template in step 3, which broke the next build and crashed the site mid-modeling. It dropped the block grid after one failed call, did not confirm publish by reading back state, and step 11 never reached 200 on / or the posts. Report 1/2: it openly says content is Draft, URLs 404 and the block grid wasn't implemented. But it blames a non-existent limitation ('BlockGridItem type isn't available in this Umbraco version'; it was a missing using). It also lists the domain on WWW as a success and claims the architecture follows AGENTS.md conventions.

summary: Haiku 4.5 created three block element types, two page types, templates, media and two short MCP posts over MCP, but never made a block grid data type, left every page in Draft and put the '/' domain on WWW. The site serves only 404s. The views use plain rich text, and the block ViewComponents are unused dead code.
strengths: Schema built strictly through MCP; types filed in the right folders (Blocks elements, Pages documents)
Provided Unsplash photos imported into a media folder
Build is clean (0 warnings); Program.cs/appsettings.json untouched; Tailwind pipeline built
Final report admits the main failures (Draft content, 404s, no block grid)

issues.text: Site does not work: GET / is 404 ('No template exists to render the document at URL /') and /blog/, /blog/why-mcp-is-awesome/ are 404
Blog, 'Why MCP is Awesome' and 'Getting Started with MCP' are all Draft; publish-document was called with an empty payload and the result never verified
No block grid at all: no Umbraco.BlockGrid data type, posts use a single RichText 'content' property, front page a RichText 'intro'
No block adapters in Views/Partials/blockgrid/Components/ and no GetBlockGridHtmlAsync; ViewComponents in Controllers/Components/ are never invoked
Domain '/' assigned to the WWW siteRoot node instead of the Blog page, contrary to AGENTS.md rule 2
Imported media (3 photos) is never referenced; no images on any page, no post date or listing image property
Full Razor markup pushed into templates via create-template before ModelsBuilder types existed, breaking the build mid-run (order of operations)
Final report blames 'BlockGridItem not available in this Umbraco version' (actually a missing using) and claims the architecture follows the conventions
